newsitem.title: USA: EIS sees Q3 revs/earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: EIS sees Q3 revs/earnings below estimates.

text.p: EIS International Inc said Thursday it will not meet analysts' third quarter revenue and earnings estimates because of delays in key orders and disappointing results from its international efforts.

The company said it expects to take third quarter charges totalling $5.3 million to cover an inventory writedown of $1.8 million, a returned order of $2.2 million and an allowance increase of $1.3 million for doubtful accounts and sales returns.
The company said it expects to have operated at close to break-even before the charges.
First Call estimates for the company are $0.30 per share in the third quarter and $0.47 per share in the fourth quarter.
For the year-ago period, First Call figures show the company earning $0.32 per share in the third quarter of 1995.
